slot_scores.name: product_I_no_production_Q2
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether Product I has any quarter-specific production restriction, especially not being producible in Q2. The READY_TO_MODEL summary also omits this constraint.

slot_scores.name: contract_reservations_must_be_delivered
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When a product is short in a quarter (demand exceeds available units), is the shortage carried forward as a backlog that must be covered by future production, or is the unmet demand simply lost and no future production is required to make up for it?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether unmet demand is backlogged and must be covered by future production, directly targeting whether all contract reservations must eventually be delivered.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Product I can be produced in all quarters, including Q2.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about quarter-specific production restrictions for Product I, and the READY_TO_MODEL summary lists only the hours constraint and no Q2 prohibition for Product I.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot H1 about Product I not being producible in Q2 remained unresolved and was silently omitted from the model summary.

summary: The agent clarified many cost and backlog semantics well, including the requirement that all contract reservations must be delivered, but it missed the P1 restriction that Product I cannot be produced in Q2 and stopped prematurely with that hidden constraint unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
